subject: Vendor recertification & procurement gates for renewal (BrightWave)
messages:
From: Linda Su <linda.su@brightwave.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor recertification and procurement gate for upcoming renewal

Hi Olga,

We’re starting renewal discussions for BrightWave (contract RW-8421) and procurement has asked us to complete a vendor recertification and refresh our onboarding materials in the procurement portal before they’ll issue a new PO.

High-level asks from procurement:
- Confirm updated SOW and billing entity
- Provide latest security questionnaire evidence (SOC2 cert, data flow diagram)
- Confirm PO number format and any required accounts/GL codes
- Indicate whether term is changing (we’re moving from 12 -> 24 months?); they also noted a potential capacity uplift (additional dedicated tokens / reserved capacity)

Can you share the procurement-side checklist and an estimated timeline? We’re targeting a signed SOW + PO by the end of May. I’ve attached the procurement portal’s questionnaire they exported.

Thanks,
Linda
Procurement Lead, BrightWave Analytics
Attachments: current_vendor_questionnaire.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Linda Su <linda.su@brightwave.com>
Cc: Mike Johnson <mike.j@brightwave.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor recertification and procurement gate for upcoming renewal

Hi Linda —

Thanks for the heads up. This is straightforward from our side, we can support the procurement portal refresh and map the required artifacts to the questionnaire. I’m including a short playbook below and attaching our renewal playbook draft.

Proposed procurement gates & timeline (high-level):
1) Week 1 (today–Apr 30): Confirm billing entity, PO format, and whether term/qty changes are expected.
2) Week 2 (May 3–7): Redwood to upload updated SOW + SOC2 report link + redacted network diagram into BrightWave portal.
3) Week 3 (May 10–14): Procurement review / Q&A.
4) Week 4 (May 17–21): Final sign & PO issuance.

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm which billing entity (BrightWave US or BrightWave Global) the PO will be issued to
- Any mandatory procurement fields (GL, cost center) we should pre-populate
- Whether the procurement team requires a 24-month term or is open to a 12-month + capacity addendum

Docs attached: Redwood_renewal_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook + sample SOW checklist). I’ll coordinate internally and loop in legal and account for the SOW redline and any commercial adjustments. We’ll send a DocuSign link for the updated SOW once we have the final terms.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Attachments: Redwood_renewal_playbook_v1.pdf

Subject: FW: Vendor recertification and procurement gate for upcoming renewal — BrightWave (coordination)

Team — forwarding BrightWave procurement’s ask and my reply. TL;DR: procurement needs the portal evidence & an SOW + PO by end of May; BrightWave is evaluating a term length change and a capacity uplift.

Action items for us:
- Karthik: can you confirm the legal checklist items we need to surface in the procurement portal (redline tolerances, preferred indemnities, and whether the SOC2 link + signed AICPA attestation is sufficient)? Also flag anything that would require a legal escalation if they insist on non-standard terms.
- Ben: please confirm whether the account expects any pricing concessions for a 24-month term or scale pricing on capacity uplift. If sales is comfortable with a limited expansion credit, propose numbers (I’d like a conservative and an optimistic figure).
- Vanessa: prepare a short migration/ops note describing how we’ll onboard the additional capacity (if approved) and any expected timeline/lead time for reserved GPU pools.

Quoted below is my reply to keep context:
